newsitem.title: UK: Norwich Union poised to reveal float details - FT.
newsitem.headline: Norwich Union poised to reveal float details - FT.

text.p: UK mutual insurance group Norwich Union is expected to reveal details of a 4.5 billion sterling ($7 billion) flotation on Wednesday, the Financial Times said.
The newspaper said the float would feature an average of 700 sterling in free shares to each of its three million life insurance policy holders. It said the group had declined to comment.
Norwich Union decided last year to consider converting to a public company to gain access to equity capital for expansion, the Financial Times said.
